block.comment: Normal follow fallback: F=10 holds; left/right proportional steering; F=0 without a recent turn direction holds 40 loops, then stops. Sharp-turn state and its latched timeout have priority.
Original 115200-baud raw ADC/F telemetry; no new capture protocol.
Position weights: A4=-1, A3=0, A2=+1. Integer proportional inner PWM; minimum5.
Exclude A1 and A5 from decisions; control uses A4/A3/A2 only.
Read all five ADCs; preserve original raw telemetry.
Three-center-sensor control with sharp-corner pivot recovery. A4/A3/A2 control only; A5/A1 raw telemetry. PWM100, threshold70, TURN_KP75. Button waits at boot only. Turn timeout needs reset.
Bounded left/right pivot for sharp 60/90-degree corners. End on centered line, not a measured angle. Timeout latches stop until reset; no automatic restart.
